name: Distant Thunder
blurb: The artillery battery at Fort Defiance is ready to deal a blow to the Scorched.

stages.log_text: The Artillery Battery at Fort Defiance is online and has Scorched targets available. A forward observer needs to go and use a Recon Scope to mark the targets for the artillery.
The targets are marked. Artillery is inbound. It's time to evacuate the area.
